svg.text: WS2812B strip (data direction →), +5V from the Teensy’s VIN,
the USB 5 V: a short strip at brightness 20 or less
bridge if the rail is split here
magenta at pins 22–23 (J16 to J15): the loopback jumper, left in place
red dashed, MB102 5 V to VIN (I12): standalone only, plugged in with the Teensy’s USB unplugged
the INMP441’s pin order varies by maker: follow its silkscreen
